def _cleanup_container(self, cinfo):
        """
        Remove a container and clean up its image if necessary.
        """
        # Remove the container.
        self.client.remove_container(cinfo["Id"], force=True)
        # Clean up the image if it was created.
        if cinfo["Config"]["Image"] not in self.client.images():
            self.client.remove_image(cinfo["Config"]["Image"])
